questions.history: Generate the annotation use with value 12345678910L. Compile the new class with the annotation declaration on the compiler classpath.
questions.prediction: Issue #993 reports a compiler complaint about an oversized integer literal before. After, expect decimal text 12345678910L and successful compilation.
questions.basis: The decimal number exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE and fits in long. An unsuffixed positive decimal integer literal of that magnitude is invalid here.
questions.refutation: The literal lacks a long suffix or javac rejects the generated member value on the merge.

questions.prediction: Both should emit an int-compatible literal and compile to a class whose reflected member equals 7.

questions.refutation: The generator adds a long suffix that makes the int member uncompilable, or reflection reads another value.

questions.history: Use a long[] member containing 7L and −2147483649L. Compile, load the generated class, retrieve its annotation and read the array.
questions.prediction: On the merge the recovered array must contain those two longs in order, including the negative value.
